Package org.bsc.langgraph4j.action

Interface InterruptableAction<State extends AgentState>

Type Parameters:
State - The type of the agent state, which must extend AgentState.
All Known Implementing Classes:
AgentEx.ApprovalNodeAction
public interface InterruptableAction<State extends AgentState>
Defines a contract for actions that can interrupt the execution of a graph. This is a functional interface whose functional method is interrupt(String, AgentState).
